model: A bounded, deterministic read-model query surface over indexed record references. History remains append-only; reorged records are marked inactive rather than deleted, while active-only queries exclude them by default.
invariants: historical records are append-only by record ID
reorged/orphaned records remain addressable and are represented as inactive rather than deleted
query result order is deterministic in canonical index insertion order
cursor identity binds schema version and complete query filter semantics
a cursor cannot be replayed against a different filter
pagination is bounded to 100 records per page
terminal pages return a zero cursor
history classes cover trades, fills, orders, cancellations, liquidity, bridge activity, route state and fee routing
query state grants no execution, custody, mint, burn or settlement authority
